description: Compare 2–5 Texas utility providers side by side when the user is deciding between specific named options at a new address. Use when the user says 'help me pick between these two', 'which is cheaper for my Dallas home, TXU or Reliant', or 'compare these internet plans before I move in'. Returns a structured comparison across price, contract terms and features so the user can see the differences before choosing. Sequencing: best after search_utility_providers has surfaced the candidate REPs at the address; retail electricity providers are not scored where residents cannot choose (no_choice or unknown in electricityMarket); they are listed under notCompared with the reason, and at a split ZIP the recommendation starts with the check-your-address caveat. Don't use this to compare across utility types (e.g. electricity vs solar); call search_utility_providers per type instead. Electricity plans are ordered and value-scored by estimated annual cost on the 500, 1,000 and 2,000 kWh prices (annualCostEstimate per plan); plans flagged billCreditCliff go last unless include_bill_credit_plans is true.

address.description: Full street address for plan availability

include_bill_credit_plans.description: Electricity only. Default false: plans whose low price depends on using about 1,000 kWh a month (bill-credit cliff in the facts label) are flagged and ranked after other plans. Set true to rank them purely on estimated annual cost.

name: compare_providers
